mapper.insert:
insert into public.vehicle_position_history ( vehicle_id, route_id, recorded_at, geom, distance_meters, total_distance_meters, route_progress_percent, speed_meters_per_second, motion_status, operational_status )
VALUES
( #{record.vehicleId}, #{record.routeId}, #{record.recordedAt},
ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint( CAST( #{record.longitude} AS double precision ), CAST( #{record.latitude} AS double precision ) ), 4326 ),
#{record.distanceMeters}, #{record.totalDistanceMeters}, #{record.routeProgressPercent}, #{record.speedMetersPerSecond},
#{record.motionStatus}, #{record.operationalStatus} )
mapper.select:
select history.vehicle_id, history.route_id, route.fid as route_fid, route.rname as route_name, min(history.recorded_at) as first_recorded_at, max(history.recorded_at) as last_recorded_at, count(*) as point_count
from public.vehicle_position_history history
join public.routes route on route.route_id = history.route_id
group by history.vehicle_id, history.route_id, route.fid, route.rname
order by route.rname, history.vehicle_id

select recorded_at,
st_x(geom) as longitude, st_y(geom) as latitude,
distance_meters, total_distance_meters, route_progress_percent, speed_meters_per_second, motion_status, operational_status
from public.vehicle_position_history
where vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} and recorded_at >= #{startTime} and recorded_at <= #{endTime}
order by recorded_at
